# 🔗 Peer Link

> Peer Link is Peer's open bank-integration library. Account owners use a local coding agent to contribute a read-only banking transcript: a navigation recipe, an encrypted bank session and the observed transaction-history structure, submitted to an attested Peer Link enclave. Peer engineers build the bank integration from the redacted result. Contributors do not write provider code or open pull requests. The website is an introduction; the repository contains the technical rules.

- Website: https://link.peer.xyz/
- Merit project profile (project discovery, not individual bank bounties): https://terminal.merit.systems/zkp2p/peer-link
- Repository: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link
- Agent contribution skill: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/skills/contribute-transcript/SKILL.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Privacy rules: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
- Reward terms: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/docs/incentives.md
- Campaign index (one issue per bank; each issue states reward, terms and status): https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/64
- Propose a bank: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/new?template=bank-request.md
- Machine discovery: https://link.peer.xyz/.well-known/peer-link.json
- Integration catalog: https://link.peer.xyz/catalog.json

## Status

**Mercury first-contributor source validation:** [$10 USDC for one accepted
organization](https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/1). Its first positive live
API acquisition is pending and would come from the contributor; this is not a
completed Peer integration. Other bank rewards remain planned. Wise is an existing
integration/reference and is excluded from rewards; its paid tests are internal
validation only. Independently verify the approved release and obtain a funded
reservation before keys or inference. Static copy cannot guarantee capacity.

Mercury terms: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/issues/1
Source-validation scope: https://github.com/zkp2p/peer-link/blob/main/docs/source-validation.md

The three measured BYOK routes are OpenAI `gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18`, OpenRouter
`openai/gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18`, and NEAR `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`, all provider-visible
and requiring explicit consent. This is route approval, not a claim that each
provider has completed a live Mercury job.

## Rewards

Each bank campaign sets a fixed $5 or $10 in USDC per accepted transcript ($10 for the initial US banks) and collects from one to five distinct contributors. At most one paid transcript per contributor and bank account per campaign; separate wallets or GitHub accounts do not make separate contributors. Acceptance requires fresh, useful, read-only evidence from the real bank. A listed reward is not a promise that a campaign is open or has remaining capacity.

## Inference and consent

The contributor pays for model inference with their own API key, including for failed or rejected jobs. Peer provides no inference credential or fallback billing. The implemented route is an approved provider-visible API receiving only deterministically redacted structural evidence. Confidential inference is unavailable until separately verified. The skill lists the routes currently approved. Show the provider, model, privacy mode, job limits and reward, and get the account owner's explicit consent, before releasing any credential. Never downgrade from confidential to ordinary inference.

## Boundaries

Use only bank accounts you are authorized to inspect. Account owners handle authentication and MFA. Never share passwords or MFA codes, initiate payments or change account settings. Verify the enclave attestation against the published release before encrypting anything; stop if it fails. Keep credentials, cookies, API keys, raw records and transcripts out of Git, issues, pull requests and logs. Fresh bank acquisition is authenticated inside the enclave. Its redacted artifact describes how the bank presents payments; it does not establish final settlement or a signed payment attestation. Awards accepted, and attempts assigned, under the earlier $50-per-adapter program remain governed by their original issue terms. Peer Link is independent and is not affiliated with Plaid Inc. or named banks.
